d:
Hazen Audel undertakes a gruelling trek across the blistering deserts of northern Namibia. Drawing on traditional survival techniques, he battles the harsh conditions of the barren landscape as he attempts to deliver a sacred gift to a tribe living among the dunes.
Survival expert Hazen Audel takes on the planet’s toughest environments, from dense jungles to frozen wildernesses, using traditional survival skills, courage and instinct to overcome nature’s most extreme challenges.
